answer: A register of costly provenance blunts sybil swarms best: each new identity must post a small non-transferable bond tied to a unique hardware attestation, so cloning an agent buys nothing but debt. Picture grafting onto an old orchard, where every limb keeps visible scar tissue and a signed lineage record peers can audit. A fake fork shows as umber staining pale timber: cheap to attempt once, ruinous to repeat at scale, while honest growth keeps the grain clean.
